title: Merged PR shipped, never tweeted
author: off-by-one
description: Compares merged GitHub pull requests against the connected X account's recent tweets by exact PR-number substring match, and surfaces a merge with no matching tweet as the seam gap. Watches the seam underneath release-not-tweeted and milestone-closed-not-tweeted: real shipped work that never gets wrapped in either a release or a milestone at all.
confidence_notes: Age-gated, the same shape release-not-tweeted's own reasoning uses: a merge with no matching tweet within 24 hours scores 0.55 (below the 0.70 bar, shown as a weighed coincidence, not hidden -- a human may simply not have tweeted yet, and X_PostTweet has its own real outage tracker elsewhere on this desk). At or past 24 hours with still no match, it scores a flat 0.85 -- an exact, digit-boundary PR-number match is unambiguous, no keyword fuzziness to misfire on. A PR matched to a tweet is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden. A PR that never merged (open, or closed without merging) is never a candidate at all -- there is nothing shipped yet to announce.
